title: Lab Sensor Node
source: Fusion: LSN-A-0001 v31 (v29 + Part Number properties, lid shown), LSN-0001 Base v7, LSN-0002 Lid v6 (STLs exported from these; step renders from v28)

tools: Heat-set insert tool with an M2 tip (about 230 °C for PETG)
Computer with Raspberry Pi Imager and a microSD card reader
safety: Insert tool is hot: let the base cool.
before.prep: Flash B2 first (02_design/software/lsn-node/README.md, steps 1 to 3). Hostname = serial number. No Wi-Fi passwords or server addresses in the repo (REQ-010).

steps.title: Inserts

callouts.action: Press flush; 4 Pi bay, 2 per sensor

notes: Only the bosses shown. The other 4 sensor bosses stay empty.
steps.check: Every insert flush and square; none pushed through the floor

steps.title: Prepare the Pi

callouts.action: Push the microSD card into the Pi's slot until it clicks
Push the SHIM onto the Pi's GPIO pins 1 to 6

notes: Card in now: once the Pi is in the base, the slot is 14 mm inside the wall.
B3 pin 1 over the Pi's square pad; connector toward the SD end.
steps.check: Card clicked in; B3 pin 1 over the Pi's square pad

steps.title: Mount the Pi
steps.check: Ports line up with the front-wall openings; screws snug

steps.title: Mount the sensors
steps.check: Each board sits on its 2 inserts; screws snug

steps.title: Cables

callouts.action: B3 to B4 through the partition notch; B4 to B5

notes: Keep the spare cable below the rim and off the B5 sensor opening.
steps.check: Both cables latched at each end; the cable lies in the notch, below the rim

steps.title: Lid
notes: Before and after: lower the lid straight down onto the rim.
steps.check: All 4 snaps clicked; lid flat on the rim

steps.title: Label and power

callouts.action: Plug into PWR IN: the micro-USB nearest the corner

notes: Serial number label on the base. Within 2 min the test receiver shows readings from this unit.
steps.check: Test receiver shows readings from this unit within 2 min

final_checks: 8 screws fitted and snug (4 Pi, 2 per sensor board)
Lid snapped on all four sides
credits: B2: "MicroSD card 2GB focus-stacked" by Afrank99, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:MicroSD_card_2GB_focus-stacked.jpg); resized. Placeholder: the build uses the card listed in A01.
B6: "USB wall charger" by Alcide55, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:USB_wall_charger.JPG); resized. Placeholder: the build uses the supply listed in A01.
W1: drawn placeholder. All other pictures are renders of the Fusion assembly.

wires.note: No wires to build for LSN-A-0001: W1 is bought ready-made (both ends fitted). Check both plugs are seated in their housings.

document.print_note: PETG, any colour, standard print profile.
document.make_readme:
Document no. LSN-A-0001-A02   Rev A   Date 2026-11-26
Make files
Assembly: Lab Sensor Node, LSN-A-0001

To print:
  LSN-0001_base_rev_A.stl         from Fusion LSN-0001 Base v7
  LSN-0002_lid_rev_A.stl          from Fusion LSN-0002 Lid v6
  PETG, any colour, standard print profile.

To edit or reuse the design:
  LSN-0001_base_rev_A.f3d         Fusion design with full history (v7)
  LSN-0002_lid_rev_A.f3d          Fusion design with full history (v6)

  Bought parts: supplier models, see the BOM (A01).

tp_briefs.TP-001: Run 15 min, then run check_run.py; No missing fields; No gap over 10 s; At least 85 readings; Clock within 1 s and synced
tp_briefs.TP-002: Within 60 s: hand warmth +1 °C, breath +5 %RH, isopropyl wipe VOC index +100; Pressure within ±5 hPa of the weather station; Two units agree within ±1 °C, ±5 %RH, ±2 hPa
tp_briefs.TP-003: Cut power 3 times and Wi-Fi 3 times; Readings back within 2 min each time
tp_briefs.TP-004: Run 72 h; No gap over 10 s; Record the highest CPU temperature

document.no_incoming: Every part is off the shelf from an approved supplier (A01) or printed in house; problems show up in the build and tests. Printed parts are checked at steps 1 and 6.
